title: Standards for Administrative Dispositions against Instrumentation Businesses (Related to Article 11(1))
full_text:
■ Enforcement Rule of the Prevention of Steep Slope Disasters Act [Attached Table 2] <Amended 2021.9.7>

Standards for Administrative Dispositions against Instrumentation Businesses (Related to Article 11(1))

| Violation | Applicable statutory provision | Standard for disposition |
|---|---|---|
| 1. Obtaining registration under Article 22 of the Act by false or improper means | Article 25(1)1 of the Act | Revocation of registration |
| 2. Failing to meet the registration standards under Article 22(1) of the Act | Article 25(1)2 of the Act | Suspension of business for 2 months (revocation of registration where the violation occurs 2 or more times within 5 years) |
| 3. Coming to fall under any subparagraph of Article 23 of the Act (excluding the case where, if an executive officer of a corporation falls under subparagraph 5 of Article 23 of the Act, a replacement for that officer is appointed within 3 months) | Article 25(1)3 of the Act | Revocation of registration |
| 4. Lending an instrumentation business registration certificate or the registered name to another person, or subcontracting instrumentation work undertaken under a contract | Article 25(1)4 of the Act | Suspension of business for 2 months (revocation of registration where the violation occurs 2 or more times within 5 years) |
| 5. Preparing false instrumentation results or preparing inadequate results intentionally or through gross negligence | Article 25(1)5 of the Act | Revocation of registration |
| 6. Failing to commence business for 2 or more years after registration without justifiable grounds | Article 25(1)6 of the Act | Revocation of registration |
